reply_text:
I told Dana, in a reply to her message in #north-team, that the settled seat count for the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is **261 seats**. Ilse posted that number in the same channel on Oct 14, and nothing since has changed it. I haven't checked it against the contract, because I can't see the signed renewal and Ilse's message is the only place I found it.

What else I found, all in places Dana can see:
- **Signing:** Moss's March renewal digest says the renewal was signed on 2026-03-20 by Ilse (as acting owner) and Thea Ramaswell.
- **Earlier seat count:** In August 2025 Dana corrected herself in the channel: Amendment No. 1 took the account to 185 seats, not 180. I mentioned this so the tracker doesn't pick up the old number.

Seat counts aren't money terms, so sharing this with the North team didn't need approval.
